source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design: Christian Religious Education, Grade 9
source.notes: Fetched from easylearn.co.ke, whose curriculum-design page listed this file as 'CRE-Grade-9-Revised.pdf' — an exact match (modulo dashes/spacing) to the official KICD Google Drive filename 'CRE Grade 9 - Revised.pdf' confirmed in README.md. WebFetch could not extract text from the PDF ('unable to extract text'), but it saved the file locally; the Read tool was then used directly on that local path and parsed the full PDF text natively (including cover page, ISBN 978-9914-43-444-6, ministry forewords, ALL five strands, all sub-strand tables, assessment rubrics, and appendices), confirming this is the genuine 2024 KICD document and not a look-alike or summary. Strand/sub-strand headings, specific learning outcomes, and key inquiry questions below are transcribed verbatim from that Read output. CAVEAT: the document's own 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB-STRANDS' table (page xii) is inconsistent with its own detailed body content — the summary table lists only 2 sub-strands under Strand 2.0 (2.1, 2.2) and 5 under Strand 3.0 (3.1-3.5), but the actual body content presents 3 sub-strands under Strand 2.0 (including an untabled 'Judge Deborah' sub-strand 2.2) and 6 under Strand 3.0 (including an untabled 'Jesus' Passion, Death and Resurrection' sub-strand 3.6). This appears to be an error in KICD's own summary table, not a transcription error here. This reference follows the fuller, ground-truth body content (16 total sub-strands) rather than the truncated summary table (14), per the instruction to never silently drop content that appears in the source.

subStrands.name: Work
specificLearningOutcomes: Interpret the scriptures on work to foster responsibility
Discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics
Choose career paths based on their gifts talents and abilities
Demonstrate a positive attitude towards work in daily activities
Desire to work hard to achieve their career goals and aspirations
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should you work hard as a Christian?

subStrands.name: Christian Moral Values
subStrands.notes: Body heading is 'Christian Moral Values: Sexual Purity'. This sub-strand is not present in the document's own summary table (which lists only 2 sub-strands for this strand) but is fully developed in the body content.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify moral values that a young person should uphold
Describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible
Utilise Christian moral values and life skills to foster sexual purity
Desire to live a morally upright life as guided by the Bible
keyInquiryQuestions: How can you live a morally upright life?
Why should you maintain sexual purity as a Christian youth?

subStrands.name: Judge Deborah
subStrands.notes: Not listed in the document's own summary table, but fully developed as its own sub-strand (2.2) in the body content, complete with SLOs, learning experiences, values, PCIs, and shared assessment rubric rows.
specificLearningOutcomes: Analyse qualities portrayed by Deborah as a judge in Israel
Deduce lessons learnt from the leadership of Judge Deborah
Appreciate those in leadership by respecting them
keyInquiryQuestions: How did Deborah portray wisdom as a Judge in Israel?

subStrands.name: Kings David and Solomon
specificLearningOutcomes: Analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ
Outline qualities of a good leader from King David's leadership
Assess the achievements and failures of King Solomon
Examine how Solomon portrayed wisdom in his leadership
Choose leaders of integrity at school, church, and in the community
keyInquiryQuestions: Why did King Solomon fail in his leadership?
Why was King David a man after God's own heart?

strands.name: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ

subStrands.name: Raising the Widow's Son
specificLearningOutcomes: Elaborate the miracle of raising the Widow's son
Interpret lessons learnt from the miracle for application in daily life
Model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ
Embrace Christian belief in the resurrection of the dead
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to believe in the resurrection of the dead as a Christian?

subStrands.name: Healing the 10 Lepers
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe the healing of the ten lepers
Devise ways of showing gratitude to God in daily life
Demonstrate faith by praying to God when faced with challenges
Apply lessons learnt by showing kindness to others
keyInquiryQuestions: How did the 10 lepers show gratitude to God?

subStrands.name: Parable on Prayer
specificLearningOutcomes: Elaborate the parable of a friend at midnight
Interpret lessons learnt from the parable of a friend at midnight
Apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life
Appreciate the parable by praying to God always
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should Christians pray at all times?
How do you exercise faith in God?

subStrands.name: Nicodemus' Encounter with Jesus Christ
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe Nicodemus' encounter with Jesus Christ
Relate the significance of the bronze serpent to the mission of Jesus Christ
Deduce lessons learnt from John 3:5-7 and its relevance in the life of a Christian
Apply lessons learnt in daily life
keyInquiryQuestions: How did Nicodemus' encounter with Jesus Christ change his life?

subStrands.name: Jesus' Ministry in Jerusalem
specificLearningOutcomes: Elaborate Jesus Christ's triumphant entry into Jerusalem
Illustrate Jesus Christ's cleansing of the temple
Describe Jesus Christ's conflict with the Jewish leaders
Desire to avoid conflicts at home, school, and in the community
keyInquiryQuestions: What was the significance of Jesus' triumphant entry to Jerusalem?
Why was Jesus opposed by the Jewish leaders?

subStrands.name: Jesus' Passion, Death and Resurrection
subStrands.notes: Not listed in the document's own summary table (which lists only 5 sub-strands for this strand, 3.1-3.5), but fully developed as sub-strand 3.6 in the body content, complete with SLOs, learning experiences, values, PCIs, and a dedicated assessment rubric.
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the significance of the Lord's Supper to Christians today
Describe the events that took place at Mount Olives
Summarise the events that took place between the arrest and the burial of Jesus Christ
Discuss the importance of Christ's resurrection to the Christian faith
Describe Jesus Christ's ascension to heaven
Recognize the second coming of Jesus Christ
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is the resurrection of Jesus Christ important to Christians today?

subStrands.name: The Early Church
specificLearningOutcomes: Discuss the characteristics of the Early Church
Describe the miracles performed in the Early Church
Outline lessons learnt from the miracles performed by the Apostles
Elaborate the story of Paul and Silas in Acts 16:16-24 and itemise lessons learnt
Describe the events in Acts 16:25-26 and lessons learnt
Desire to respond to the call of salvation as portrayed in Acts 16:30-31
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to learn about the Early Church?

subStrands.name: The Gifts of the Holy Spirit
specificLearningOutcomes: Discuss the teachings of Jesus Christ on the role of the Holy Spirit
Identify the nine gifts of the Holy Spirit
Classify the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to their categories
Utilise discerning gifts to avoid joining ungodly cults/idol worship/religious extremism
Read the scripture provided to get knowledge and avoid being lured to false religion or cults
Desire to be guided by the Holy Spirit in day-to-day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you utilize the gifts of the Holy Spirit?

subStrands.name: Courtship and Marriage
specificLearningOutcomes: Elaborate the causes and consequences of early marriage
Discuss moral values and life skills needed to avoid early marriage
Analyse Christian approaches to courtship and marriage
Appreciate marriage as a sacred institution ordained by God
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is courtship important before marriage?

subStrands.name: Responsible Parenthood
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain biblical teachings on responsible parenting from the scriptures provided
Discuss the causes of irresponsible parenting today
Compile values needed to avoid unplanned families in Kenya today
Appraise the role of parents or guardians in shaping the character of their children
Value good parenting as guided by the Bible
keyInquiryQuestions: How is responsible parenting achieved?

subStrands.name: Leisure
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline different ways of spending leisure time
Analyse how youths misuse leisure today
Evaluate five effects of alcohol, drug and substance abuse on an individual
Establish moral values and life skills needed to avoid alcohol, drug and substance abuse
Read the scriptures provided and itemize lessons learnt
Utilise Christian moral values to avoid alcohol, drug and substance abuse
keyInquiryQuestions: Why do youths misuse leisure today?
How can you avoid idleness?

subStrands.name: Wealth, Money and Poverty
specificLearningOutcomes: Discuss Christian teachings on wealth, money, and poverty
Appraise how the love of money can hinder one from inheriting the Kingdom of God
Assess five causes and remedies of poverty in the society today
Devise five ethical ways of acquiring wealth as a youth
Establish a viable business or enterprise
Manage the business by reporting its performance to the parent, guardian or the teacher
Desire to acquire wealth through credible ways as youths
keyInquiryQuestions: Which vices are associated with love for money?
Why is integrity important in handling money and wealth?
